title: blumea lacera var. javanica
intro: Blumea lacera var. javanica, commonly known as Java fleabane, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian cultures to treat various health conditions. The plant is reported to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents present in Java fleabane include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
